name: Radiant Flame keeps channeling at the range Solar Champion grants it (#1438)
contract: #1438: 'Radiant Flame interrupts casting at the max allowed range distance, it starts casting and then stops, even though it's within allowed range' (level 60 Sun Cleric). Radiant Flame rank 7 560867 is a channel (SPELL_ATTR1_IS_CHANNELED, DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms, RangeIndex 4 = 30 yd) whose effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE (227) every 1000 ms with SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD, triggering the sphere 807058 'Radiant Flame (Damage)', which has its own RangeIndex 4 (30 yd). The Piety talent Solar Champion 504734 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_RANGE +20% on class mask word0 0x8000000, which matches every Radiant Flame rank (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 0x8000000) but not the sphere (SpellFamilyFlags[2] 0x8), so a talented Sun Cleric may open the channel at 36 yd plus both combat reaches while each sphere is still range-checked strictly at 30 yd plus reaches. Spell::prepare ends a non-passive periodic aura whose triggered spell fails CheckCast (SetDuration(0) with SendChannelUpdate(0)), so the first, immediate sphere out of its own range ends the channel it belongs to: the channel starts and then stops. The tooltip ('Launch radiant spheres at an enemy ... repeating every $t1 sec for $d') makes the spheres part of the channel, so the channel's own range, which Spell::UpdateChanneledTargetList enforces with the talent and tolerance, must decide. The fixture Sun Cleric (combat reach 1.5) opens Radiant Flame with Solar Champion on a Harvest Golem (display 367, combat reach 1.275) 35 yd away: beyond the sphere's 32.8 yd but within the talented channel's 38.8 yd. Before the fix the channel is gone at once and no sphere is cast; after it the channel runs and the spheres keep landing.
